title: This Seal Holds Its Breath for Two Hours Below a Mile

scenes.text: An elephant seal can hold its breath for two hours.
It dives deeper than a mile, into total darkness.
It spends over 90 percent of its time at sea underwater.
It even sleeps down there, in short naps of about ten minutes.
Then it surfaces for a moment and dives again.
A two hour breath, a mile down.

description:
Elephant seals can hold their breath for nearly two hours and dive deeper than a mile.
They spend over 90 percent of their time at sea diving.
Could you hold your breath for even two minutes?
first_comment: How long can YOU hold your breath? Tell us in the comments.
